books.name: 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea
books.effect: Move up to 2 of your overflow Inklings from adjacent books into this overflow.

books.name: Journey to the Center of the Earth
The Aeneid
books.effect: Place an inkling in each adjacent book's overflow.

books.name: Dracula
books.effect: At conflict start, the occupant of the first page space may move 1 enemy page Inkling here to overflow.

books.name: Frankenstein
books.effect: After the first conflict here, return the overflow Inklings to supply, then move all the page Inklings here to the overflow.

books.name: Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
books.effect: Ymay discard 1 card to place 3 Inklings in this book’s overflow.

characters.name: Captain Nemo
characters.ability: ∞ When Nemo finishes a normal move, you may move any overflow Inklings from the book he started at to the book he ended.

characters.name: Phileas Fogg
characters.ability: Move to a page on a book where you have no Inklings, place an Inkling on an empty page space, and resolve the space twice.

characters.name: Achilles
characters.ability: ⚔ +2 power if an enemy character is here.

characters.name: Odysseus
characters.ability: If at least 2 players have Inklings on the book where Odysseus is, start a conflict there.

characters.name: Aeneas
characters.ability: ⚔ After a conflict where Aeneas is present, move him to an adjacent book and add 2 overflow Inklings.

characters.name: Dracula
characters.ability: If Dracula's page has only one inkling, erase it, then place yours there (ignore reward). Then take a normal turn.

characters.name: Frankenstein’s Creature
characters.ability: If you have an Inkling on the same page as Frankenstein's Monster, it gains +4 power.

characters.name: Dr. Jekyll / Mr. Hyde
characters.ability:
(Flip a coin and place it here. If you would play a Twist card, you may instead flip the coin.)
Heads: +3 power.
Tails: +1 movement.

twists.name: Ships in Company
twists.effect: +2 power, or +4 if you have 2 or more Inklings on an adjacent book.

twists.name: Charted Passage
twists.effect: +3 power, or +7 if you have Inklings on 2 adjacent books.

twists.name: Rally the Flanks
twists.effect: +2 power, or +4 if you have an Inkling on each adjacent book.

twists.name: Call to Arms
twists.effect: +5 power, or +7 if you have at least 3 cards in hand.

twists.name: Séance
twists.effect: +2 power, or +4 if you have at least 2 Inklings in this book’s overflow.

twists.name: Haunting
twists.effect: +3 power. At the end of this combat, erase an inkling from each other book.

subplots.name: A Port of Call
subplots.condition: End your move on a page with one of your inklings on each adjacent page (minimum 2).

subplots.name: In the Ship’s Wake
subplots.condition: Place an Inkling on a page adjacent to one of your other Inklings, then discard a Twist.

subplots.name: Walk the Planks
subplots.condition: Place an inkling, then discard exactly one of you inklings from two adjacent books.
subplots.ongoing: When you place on last space, gain 2 ink.

subplots.name: The Final Verse
subplots.condition: Complete a conflict where you have no Inklings in the overflow.

subplots.name: Stand Shoulder to Shoulder
subplots.condition: Place an inkling on the last space of a book while you have at least 3 cards and 3 ink.
subplots.ongoing: If you have Inklings in each overflow, +2 power.

bookmarks.name: Well Read
bookmarks.effect: When you draw any number of cards, draw 1 more.

bookmarks.name: Deep Inkwell
bookmarks.effect: Whenever you gain ink, gain 2 more.

bookmarks.name: Effortless Twists
bookmarks.effect: Each of your Twists costs -1 ink.

bookmarks.name: Hidden Strength
bookmarks.effect: When played during a conflict, your Subplots give +2 power.

bookmarks.name: An Unlikely Companion
bookmarks.effect: Gain a new character from the deck.

bookmarks.name: Strength in the Margins
bookmarks.effect: Each of your overflow Inklings has +2 power.

bookmarks.name: Command the Page
bookmarks.effect: Each of your Inklings on page spaces has +2 power.

bookmarks.name: Double Take
bookmarks.effect: During conflict, each inkling allows you to play 2 cards.

bookmarks.name: Make Room
bookmarks.effect: When placing an inkling onto a page space, you may first move an opponent's inkling from that space to the overflow.

bookmarks.name: Ink in the Margins
bookmarks.effect: At the end of a conflict, if you lost, gain 2 ink per Inkling you had there.
